scripts.test:negative: npm run prepare-db && E2E_SIMULATE_BROKEN_LOGOUT=1 playwright test
scripts.test:desktop: npm run prepare-db && node ../desktop/scripts/test-profile.mjs ../desktop/.test-profile http://127.0.0.1:3000 && node ../desktop/scripts/build.mjs prepare --profile ../desktop/.test-profile --api http://127.0.0.1:3000 --allow-insecure-loopback && xvfb-run -a playwright test -c playwright.desktop.config.ts
scripts.test:desktop:packaged: npm run prepare-db && node ../desktop/scripts/test-profile.mjs ../desktop/.test-profile http://127.0.0.1:3000 && node ../desktop/scripts/build.mjs package --dir --profile ../desktop/.test-profile --api http://127.0.0.1:3000 --allow-insecure-loopback && DESKTOP_EXECUTABLE="$(ls ../desktop/release/linux-unpacked/shikkhaos-e2e-*  | head -1)" xvfb-run -a playwright test -c playwright.desktop.config.ts
scripts.test:desktop:negative: npm run prepare-db && node ../desktop/scripts/test-profile.mjs ../desktop/.test-profile http://127.0.0.1:3000 && node ../desktop/scripts/build.mjs prepare --profile ../desktop/.test-profile --api http://127.0.0.1:3000 --allow-insecure-loopback && E2E_SIMULATE_BROKEN_LOGOUT=1 xvfb-run -a playwright test -c playwright.desktop.config.ts
